summary: Mark Dropbox delete, move, restore, tag-remove, link-revoke, and delete-all-closed MCP tools as destructive.
reason: The generator emits destructiveHint=false for every non-read POST; Dropbox sends all calls as POST, so destructive tools were advertised as safe to auto-approve.
validated_outcome: TestDropboxMutatingToolsAreDestructive asserts the hint on all eight tools and fails if a regeneration drops the patch.
